sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Navin Chawla
 Order

% 14.02.2024 CRL.M.A. 4707/2024 (Exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. This application is filed by the Applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 seeking grant of Regular Bail in case arising out of FIR No. 282/2023 dated 30.05.23 registered at Police Station: Sagarpur under Sections 498A/304B of the Indian Penal Code 1860.
4. Notice is accepted by Mr.Aman Usman, learned APP.

5. Let Status Report be filed before the next date of hearing.
6. Let Nominal Roll of the appellant be called for from the concerned Jail Superintendent and be placed on record well before the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
